Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II, EDSA, Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 134 S. 2010 SEP MS. MARILYN O. SALOMON Municipal Social Welfare & Devt. Officer MS. LEAH L. ANIBAN MS. LYDIA P. BARQUILLA MS. ROSANNA T. APA-AP Municipal Social Welfare & Devt Office MUNICIPALITY OF PANGANTUCAN Province of Bukidnon Dear Mesdames: This has reference to your letter dated 05 August 2010 pertaining to your claim for Hazard Pay. You further alleged that the Municipal Accountant Mr. Renato G. Sabado and Resident Auditor Mrs. Cecilia Pantuja required you and your staff to submit accomplishment reports in support of the hazard pay claims. To your knowledge, such requirement is not necessary as the same is not provided in Republic Act No. 9433, otherwise known as 'Magna Carta for Public Social Workers", and its Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR). You were compelled to seek assistance from this Department since Municipal Accountant Sabado and Resident Auditor Pantuja have not given you any clear decision on the claim of Hazard Pay. The acts of the said officials, according to you, were tantamount to violation of Republic Act No. 9485, or the Anti-Red Tape Law. In response to the above, we refer to the same law, R.A. 9433 and its IRR. Hazard Allowance is given to public social workers assigned in remote and depressed areas, strife-torn or embattled areas, distressed or isolated stations, mental hospitals, leprosaria, areas declared under a state of calamity or emergency which expose them to great danger, volcanic activity/eruption, occupational risks or threats to life. (Section 15 [11, R.A. 9433) Section 16.1.2.4 IRR of R.A. 9433 further provides that the period of entitlement to Hazard Pay shall be co-terminus with the duration of the actual assignment of the official or employee in work areas or situations mentioned in the preceding paragraph. As to the proper official authorized to determine the procedure for entitlement of it iS the Head of the Agency/ Local the Hazard Allowance and the duration thereof, Chief Executive who shall approve which positions are exposed to occupational risks and hazards based on the list of plantilla positions with corresponding duties and justification for the claim, duly prepared by the agency or Local Government Unit. The Head of Agency /Local Chief Executive is mandated by law to establish

-2- the procedure for identifying these personnel who shall be exposed to hazardous areas and occupational risks. (Sections 16.1.2. to 16.1.2.3, IRR of R.A. 9433) Your letter did not mention of any established procedure relative to the entitlement and determination of personnel exposed to hazards. It is therefore proposed that you immediately coordinate with the Municipal Mayor of Pangantucan Manolita G. Garces to commence the establishment of the proper procedure relative to Hazard Allowance entitlement. We hope that we sufficiently addressed your concerns. Very truly yours, ATTY. JESU B. DOQU IV Director III cc. RD LORETO BHAGWANI, MSNA, CESO IV DILG Region 10 Masterson Avenue, Km 3, Upper Carmen Cagayan De Oro City 9000 PD RONELO p.
